scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with a tree in the middle, lined with buildings on both sides, and a few people riding bikes along the sidewalk. The sky is blue with some clouds, and there are white lines painted on the ground to indicate pedestrian crossings and bike lanes. There are also several trees lining the street, casting shadows over the area. The buildings have different architectural styles, with some having balconies and others being more modern. The street is relatively empty, but there are a few cars parked along the side of the road.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on the left side of the street are older, with ornate facades and balconies. The building on the right has a more modern design, with large windows and a flat roof. There are also several shops and restaurants along the street, including a cafe with outdoor seating.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt, and there are several trees planted along the sidewalk. The buildings' facades are made of stone, brick, and concrete, with some having metal railings and others having decorative elements like columns and arches. The streetlights are tall and slender, with a modern design.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and bike racks along the sidewalk, providing places for pedestrians and cyclists to rest and park their bikes. There are also several trash cans and recycling bins scattered throughout the area.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are tall and leafy, providing shade and beauty to the area. They are spaced evenly apart, creating a sense of rhythm and harmony.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including traffic signs, directional signs, and advertisements. Some of the signs are old and faded, while others are newer and more modern.
scene_analysis.as_resident: This street seems to be a popular spot for locals, with several people sitting outside cafes and restaurants. There are also several shops and services available, including a pharmacy and a bank.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: This street is a convenient location for commuters, with several bus stops and bike racks nearby. There are also several parking meters and bike-share stations.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: This street is a great spot for tourists to take photos and enjoy the sights and sounds of the city. There are several street performers and artists adding to the lively atmosphere.
scene_analysis.as_student: This street is a great place for students to study or work, with several libraries and study areas visible. There are also several quiet spots for reading and relaxation.
